roads.name: Polpis Road
words: Sweeping and steady: 12 curves in 2.4 miles.
From 5 to 27 ft, with 108 ft of up and down along the way.
roads.ratingNote: Bars show where it sits among the region's roads; the numbers are each part's share of the rating. At the 35 mph limit its curves ask for about 0.21 g.
